title: templategroup.get
description: Retrieve template groups according to the given parameters.

graphids.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with the given graphs.

groupids.description: Return only template groups with the given template group IDs.

templateids.description: Return only template groups that contain the given templates.

triggerids.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with the given triggers.

with_graphs.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with graphs.

with_graph_prototypes.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with graph prototypes.

with_httptests.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with web checks.

with_items.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with items. Overrides the with_simple_graph_items parameters.

with_item_prototypes.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with item prototypes. Overrides the with_simple_graph_item_prototypes parameter.

with_simple_graph_item_prototypes.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with item prototypes, which are enabled for creation and have numeric type of information.

with_simple_graph_items.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with numeric items.

with_templates.description: Return only template groups that contain templates.

with_triggers.description: Return only template groups that contain templates with triggers.

selectTemplates.description: Return a templates property with the templates that belong to the template group. See the Template object (reference/template/object). Supports count.

limitSelects.description: Limits the number of records returned by subselects. Applies to the following subselects: selectTemplates - results will be sorted by template.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values: groupid, name.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
